title: External Landscaping
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Ducting runs in and photographed before backfill?
Drainage runs laid and tested before backfill?
ACO channel to line and level, joints tight, grating seated?
Sump units installed and photographed before backfill?
Ask the fitter: What falls and joint widths are you working to? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Paving to line, level and falls with joints filled; kerbs straight?
Trees staked and tied, planting healthy, irrigation in where shown?
Sub-base laid within ±10 mm, basecourse ±6 mm, surfaces ±6 mm of level?

guide.title: Landscape – EPR 48
rows: 3 mm max (5 mm max level difference)
±10 mm of alignment; ±5 mm in any 10 m

questions.q: Excavation to the right depth; import fill compacted in layers?
Void formers and insulation laid to the landscape drawing, no gaps?
Ducts at the drawing size and depth, warning tape above them (UKPN to their arrangement)?
Paving matches the benchmark; bedding and grout as specified, joint widths even?
Street furniture, bollards, handrails and precast elements fixed and aligned?
In-situ concrete: rebar checked before the pour, cured, no cracking?

notOk.t: Tree roots exposed with no protection

ask.q: What levels tolerance on sub-base, basecourse and surface?
ask.a: Sub-base ±10 mm, basecourse ±6 mm, surfaces ±6 mm.

ask.q: What's the max undulation on paving?
What gratings go in pedestrian areas?
